info.name: Daway — Mobile API
info.description:
Complete collection for the Daway mobile (Sanctum) API. Covers patient and pharmacy flows: OTP auth, public catalog, patient/pharmacy profiles, medicines, inventory, alternatives, patient inquiries, pharmacy inquiries, ratings, and notifications.

**Setup**
1. Set the `base_url` variable (default: `https://daway-backend.onrender.com`).
2. Run `Auth → OTP Send` then `Auth → OTP Verify` (or `Auth → Login Pharmacy`). The bearer token is saved automatically to the `token` variable.
3. All other endpoints inherit the bearer auth from the collection.

Base folder: `app/Http/Controllers/Api/`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: OTP-based patient login and pharmacy email/password login. Tokens are auto-captured.

request.description: Send a 6-digit OTP to a phone number. Response includes the OTP (intentional — no SMS gateway yet) plus `is_registered` (true = existing user, false = new user that requires registration data on verify).
Verify OTP for an EXISTING user. Returns Sanctum token (auto-captured) and `is_new: false`.

item.name: Register Patient (OTP verify with registration data)

request.description: Create a NEW patient account. Required: phone, otp, name, birth_date (<= today), latitude, longitude (GPS from Flutter — mandatory), notifications_enabled (optional boolean). Calling without registration data for an unregistered phone returns 422 with `registration_required: true`; the OTP stays valid, resend it with the full body. Location/notifications permission prompts are handled by Flutter.
Alias of /api/otp/verify.
Pharmacy login with `pharmacy_custom_id` (e.g. PH-1234) and password.
Revoke the current bearer token.
Issue a new token and revoke the previous one.

item.name: Public Catalog
item.description: No auth required.

request.description: List MOH catalog medicines (with optional search).
Cross-catalog search (local + MOH).
Find medicines by active ingredient.
Medicine detail with pharmacies that carry it.
List active pharmacies carrying the medicine with stock.
List active pharmacies (with optional name/medicine filters).
Pharmacy detail with hours, ratings, and available medicines.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Patient and pharmacy profile endpoints (auth required).

item.name: Categories
item.description: Public catalog metadata — no auth required. Available-only by default for patient endpoints.

request.description: All active categories with subcategories and available-medicines counts.
Single category by slug or ID.
MOH medicines in a category — patient default: available-only (active pharmacy + in stock). Admin: use `/api/admin/categories/{slug}/medicines` for full catalog.
Canonical dosage form list for filter UI.

item.name: Medicine Filters (all options in one call)

request.description: All filter options (categories + subcategories + dosage forms) with available-medicines counts for each.

item.name: Patient Addresses
item.description: CRUD for patient delivery addresses. Role: patient.

request.description: Validations: `recipient_name` required, `address` required, `latitude` -90..90, `longitude` -180..180. Setting `is_default: true` unsets other default addresses.

item.name: Patient Medicines
item.description: Patient-scoped medicine endpoints: search, detail, alternatives, availability.

request.description: Patient-scoped search (tracks SearchLog with 60s dedup).
Active pharmacies carrying this medicine with stock. Same as `/api/medicines/{id}/pharmacies` but patient-scoped.

item.name: Patient Favorites
item.description: Favorite medicines and pharmacies. Role: patient.

request.description: 201 if new, 200 if already favorited.

item.name: Patient Health Profile
item.description: Medical profile: allergies, chronic diseases, blood type, notes. Role: patient.

request.description: Returns `allergies` (array), `chronic_diseases` (array), `blood_type`, `notes`.

item.name: Patient Reminders
item.description: Medicine reminders with scheduled FCM push. Role: patient.

request.description: Atomically decrements `quantity_remaining` by 1. When 0 → `is_active` becomes false.

item.name: Patient Cart
item.description: Shopping cart for patient checkout. Role: patient.

request.description: Price is always taken from DB (not client). 422 if out of stock, inactive pharmacy, or quantity exceeds available stock. Duplicate medicine merges quantity instead of creating a new item.

item.name: Patient Orders
item.description: Checkout, order history, tracking, cancel. Role: patient.

request.description: Creates an order from the current cart. Server-side price calculation (ignores client prices). 422 if cart is empty, address is not yours, or any item is out of stock / unavailable. Cart is cleared on success. `coupon_code` is optional.
Only pending/confirmed/preparing orders can be cancelled. 422 if already delivered/cancelled. Inventory is NOT restored on cancel.

item.name: Patient Availability Alerts
item.description: Subscribe to be notified when a medicine becomes available (optionally at a specific pharmacy). Role: patient.

request.description: 201 if new, 200 if already subscribed. `pharmacy_id` is optional (null = any pharmacy). 422 if medicine or pharmacy doesn't exist.
403 if the alert belongs to another user.

item.name: Patient Coupons
item.description: Validate a coupon code before checkout. Role: patient.

request.description: Checks if the coupon is valid for the given order total. 404 if coupon doesn't exist, 422 if order total is below minimum.

item.name: Patient Assistant Chat
item.description: AI chat: describe what you need, get medicine + available pharmacies. Rate-limited.

request.description: Returns resolved medicine + nearest active pharmacies. `latitude`/`longitude` are optional (enables distance sorting). Logged in SearchLog with 60s dedup.

item.name: Device Tokens
item.description: Register FCM device tokens for push notifications. Works for patient and pharmacy roles.

request.description: 201 if new, 200 if updated. 422 if token belongs to another user. Idempotent for same (user_id, device_id).

item.name: Patient Inquiries
item.description: Patients ask pharmacies about medicine availability. Creating an inquiry notifies the pharmacy owner.

request.description: Triggers a `new_inquiry` notification to the pharmacy user.

item.name: Pharmacy Inquiries
item.description: Pharmacy owners manage status of incoming availability inquiries. Requires `role:pharmacy`.

request.description: Valid statuses: `new`, `answered`, `closed`.

item.name: Pharmacy Medicines
item.description: Manage a pharmacy's own inventory entries. Requires `role:pharmacy`.

request.description: Search the general catalog + MOH catalog. Arabic names are matched too and results include `name_ar` next to `name`.

Add a medicine by name directly — no IDs required.

Rules:
- `trade_name` — required, English only (any Arabic character → 422).
- `trade_name_ar` — optional, must contain Arabic when sent.
- `active_ingredient` — required.
- `image_url` — optional (direct Cloudinary URL).

Resolution order: general catalog (EN) → general catalog (AR) → MOH catalog (auto-copied) → brand-new entry. Duplicate stock line → 422. Empty fields on an existing match (Arabic name / active ingredient) get enriched from the request.

Requires `medicine_id` or `moh_medicine_id` (one of them). `min_stock` was removed — the low-stock threshold is fixed internally at 10: quantity <= 10 (>0) triggers low_stock; quantity = 0 triggers out_of_stock.

Updates price/quantity/is_available. Optional fields `trade_name` (English only), `trade_name_ar` (Arabic only), `active_ingredient` enrich the general catalog only when those fields are currently empty (never overwrite correct existing values). `min_stock` removed — alerts use the fixed threshold (10).

item.name: Pharmacy Inventory
item.description: Single + bulk stock updates with auto low/out-of-stock notifications (fixed threshold: 10 — `min_stock` was removed from the API).

item.name: Pharmacy Alternatives
item.description: Manual equivalents mapping using the `alternative_medicine` pivot.

item.name: Pharmacy Dashboard
item.description: Aggregate stats for the mobile dashboard.

item.name: Ratings
item.description: Patients rate pharmacies; pharmacy owners can list their own ratings. New ratings auto-notify the pharmacy.

request.description: Triggers `new_rating` notification to the pharmacy user. Pharmacy must be active.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Mobile notification feed (replaces web `/api/notifications/*` for mobile callers).
